title: Dexterous Robotic Hands in the Foundation-Model Era: A Full-Stack Survey of Hardware, Data, Cross-Embodiment Transfer, Learning, and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dexterous robotic hands are increasingly coupled to large-scale human data and foundation models, yet progress in hardware, representation learning and evaluation is often assessed separately. This survey reviews work from January 2024 to early November 2026, with earlier studies included to establish technical lineages. We organize the literature into five interdependent layers: hardware; data collection and curation; cross-embodiment transfer; learning and foundation models; and evaluation and applications. Human hand-object understanding and tactile sensing provide two cross-cutting perspectives. A system-level architecture, comparative tables and five case analyses connect design choices across these layers. We distinguish within-study experimental comparisons from heterogeneous corpus statistics, vendor specifications and company-reported results. Three conclusions emerge. translated_title: 基础模型时代的灵巧机械手：硬件、数据、跨本体迁移、学习与评估的全栈式综述
translated_abstract: 灵巧机械手正日益与大规模人类数据和基础模型深度结合，然而硬件、表征学习与评估等方面的进展往往被割裂地单独评估。本综述回顾了2024年1月至2026年11月初的相关工作，并纳入更早期的研究以梳理技术发展脉络。我们将文献组织为五个相互依赖的层次：硬件；数据采集与整理；跨本体迁移；学习与基础模型；以及评估与应用。人手-物体交互理解与触觉感知提供了两个贯穿全文的横切视角。通过系统级架构、对比表格和五个案例分析，我们将各层次之间的设计选择串联起来。研究区分了单一研究内部的实验对比与异构语料库统计、厂商规格参数以及公司报告的结果。综述最终得出三点结论，其中第一点是：人类数据的价值取决于运动学、视觉等方面的特性。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 这是一篇全栈式综述，首次将基础模型时代的灵巧机械手研究系统性地组织为硬件、数据、跨本体迁移、学习与评估五个相互依赖的层次，并通过案例分析揭示各层设计选择之间的内在联系。
en_tdlr: This full-stack survey systematically organizes dexterous robotic hand research in the foundation-model era into five interdependent layers—hardware, data, cross-embodiment transfer, learning, and evaluation—revealing how design choices connect across the entire stack.
